items.title: Disability benefit review calls for closer link with claimant costs
items.summary: A government-commissioned report calls for a "rebalancing" of the amount paid to different claimants.

items.title: 'Unknown substance' released at rap concert could be linked to 'robberies', police say
items.summary: The "unknown substance" that sparked a mass evacuation at a rap concert could be linked to robberies and reports of jewellery being stolen, police say.

items.title: Two arrested on suspicion of burglary at Prince and Princess of Wales's Norfolk home
items.summary: The break-in took place at the family's country retreat in Norfolk, on the Sandringham Estate.

items.title: Two men arrested over suspected burglary at William and Kate's home
items.summary: Two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at William and Kate's Norfolk home.

items.title: Huntley murderer handed new whole life jail term
items.summary: Triple killer Anthony Russell admits murdering child killer Ian Huntley at Frankland Prison.

items.title: London Underground strike to go ahead after talks break down
items.summary: A 24-hour strike by London Tube drivers is set to go ahead this week after talks failed to resolve the dispute.
